bias.en: Bearish · back above the Oct 16 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收回 10月16日低点上方

read.en: Applied Materials rose 1.0% on Oct 21 to $408.94, trading between $406.18 and $414.00. It is below its falling 5-day ($413.3), 10-day ($449.1), 30-day ($468.9) and 100-day ($515.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($441.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($480.72), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月21日上涨 1.0%，收于 $408.94，盘中区间 $406.18–414.00。股价位于下行的 5 日（$413.3）、10 日（$449.1）、30 日（$468.9）和 100 日均线（$515.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$441.1）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$480.72），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $407.3 Oct 16 low, which turns back into support, but the high stalled just above the 5-day average. Resistance is $413.3–414 (5-day, Oct 21 high), then $418 (Oct 15 low) and $441 (200-day). Support is $406–407.3, then $397–399 (May 19 and Oct 20 lows) and $377–380. A close above $418 would target $441; a close below $397 would open $377–380.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $407.3 的 10月16日低点，该位重新转为支撑，但盘中高点仅略高于 5 日均线即受阻。阻力为 $413.3–414（5 日均线、10月21日高点），其次 $418（10月15日低点）和 $441（200 日均线）。支撑为 $406–407.3，其次 $397–399（5月19日和10月20日低点）和 $377–380。若收盘站上 $418，下一目标看 $441；若收盘跌破 $397，将打开 $377–380。
